Coverage_Description: Annual Hong Kong study protection for visiting university students: hospitalisation expenses up to HK$300,000/year, personal accident up to HK$600,000/year, tuition-related interru
customer requirement: University students studying in Hong Kong from Mainland China or overseas
price structure: Annual premium; renewal no-claim discount 10% after 1 claim-free year, 20% after 2 consecutive claim-free years
additional informations: No excess for all sections; coverage suspension allowed once per policy year for up to 3 months due to study interruption
